purpose: Phase 4 check of the data-sending settings of the pilot model endpoints

deepseek-v4.1-flash.retention: prompts retained for an unknown period (OpenRouter table for the DeepSeek provider; same company)

what_is_sent: only the chat messages built by the harness (public task view, tool catalog, public results); no benchmark name (blinding firewall), no private site values, seeds or paths (leak scanner); no project-identifying headers; OpenRouter attaches the account's user id
risk: DeepSeek may train on the prompts, so the task text and environment responses could enter future DeepSeek training data; to be stated in the paper. Avoidable only by routing DeepSeek through a zero-retention provider instead of the official API.
status: documented; no change made (the official DeepSeek API was the user's choice)
